content.bridge_context: We use the fun theme of jumping animals to explore skip-counting, number lines, and common multiples.

units.title: Skip Counting
units.explanation: Counting by skipping a fixed number of steps (e.g., counting by 3s: 3, 6, 9...).
units.dual_language_instruction: Count by jumps. / कूदते हुए गिनें।

units.title: Number Line Interactions
units.explanation: Visualizing jumps on a horizontal line where each mark represents a number.
units.dual_language_instruction: Mark the landing spots. / उतरने के स्थानों को चिह्नित करें।
